text:
tessa: Heads-up — we saw a propagation delay in our onboarding pipeline that delayed feature flag activation and initial data ingest for ~20 trial tenants created 2026-12-02 -> 2026-12-04 (mostly EU region). Putting together customer comms, compensation, and enablement options.

omar: Can you drop the impacted list? Ill loop AEs for the high-touch ones.

tessa: Full list in the sheet: https://redwood.internal/cs/prop-delay-dec2026. High-touch flagged: AuroraMed, PaperForge, LatticeAI. Most tenants became available after manual replay; a few saw missing sample indexes we rebuilt.

linh: Infra summary: a config rollout race left a small window where the onboarding flow skipped a post-provisioning hook, causing delayed index creation and flag activation. We rolled a targeted rollback and replay tool. Fix deployed 2026-12-05T01:30Z.

ops-bot: deploybot: hotfix/2026-12-05-onboard-prop-fix deployed by @linh at 2026-12-05T01:30Z :white_check_mark:

tessa: Thanks. Need: customer-facing 2-sentence RCA, credit/comp plan, office hours + 1:1 plan, and a short feedback capture so we can quantify impact.

omar: From renewal POV flag AuroraMed + PaperForge as potential at-risk; AE @ae_sam please prepare a tailored outreach.

ae_sam: On it — will reach out to AuroraMed and PaperForge and offer a 30-min call. If they express friction we can escalate to a joint CS+AE session.

linh: Customer RCA draft (non-technical): "A brief configuration rollout issue temporarily delayed parts of our onboarding flow for a small set of trial accounts. We fixed the rollout, completed replays for affected setups, and verified impacted tenants are now available. We apologize for the disruption and are adding checks to avoid recurrence."

tessa: That reads well. For compensation I propose: automatically extend the affected trials by 14 days + apply a one-time $150 service credit for eligible trials; offer a free 30-min migration/enablement session for the 3 high-touch accounts. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

billing: We can apply a 14-day extension and a $150 credit per qualifying trial; we need the impacted CSV with creation timestamps to compute eligibility.

mike_support: I'll prep a 30-min enablement checklist and a short 3-question feedback form we can include in the invite. Suggest we run office hours (45m) next Tue 9am PT and collect RSVPs.

linh: Also adding monitoring: a rollout-verification probe that fails if post-provision hooks don't report within 5 minutes, plus an alert to paging when >3 tenants fail.

tessa: Action items: omar  drop a sanitized CSV into billing and notify AEs; billing  queue credits once CSV is in; ae_sam  AE outreach + 1:1 scheduling for AuroraMed/PaperForge/LatticeAI; mike_support  create enablement checklist and feedback form; linh  post final replay/backfill timestamp. I'll draft the outbound email and paste here for review.

omar: CSV uploaded to billing bucket: s3://redwood-internal/cs/prop-delay/impacted.csv. Ive pinged AE owners.

billing: Received CSV, will process credits and confirm when applied.

linh: Replay/backfill completed at 2026-12-05T03:12Z. Verified indexes and flag states for all impacted tenants. Monitoring probe added to prod.

tessa: Great. Draft email below — please review: "We're sorry — a brief configuration rollout issue temporarily delayed parts of your onboarding. We've fixed the issue, replayed affected setups, and verified access. To make this right we extended affected trials by 14 days and applied a $150 service credit where eligible. If you'd like help or a walkthrough, join our office hours (RSVP: https://redwood.internal/events/oh-2026-12-08) or request a 30-min 1:1 and we'll schedule it. Please fill a short feedback form after the session so we can learn from your experience"

omar: LGTM. Add a sentence offering to escalate to an exec-level check-in if customers signal renewal concern.

tessa: Added. Final send after billing confirms credits.

billing: Credits queued; will post confirmation when applied (ETA ~2h).

mike_support: Office hours created and RSVP form linked: https://redwood.internal/events/oh-2026-12-08  I'll send invites and attach the 3-question feedback form.

tessa: Thanks everyone. Closing notes: track responses, capture NPS delta for impacted trials, and log any escalation flags into Salesforce. Will post the outbound send timestamp here once done.
